designs.name: 晴芽 · 会抬头的小太阳
designs.motif: 杏金水滴眼＋一撮向前弯的芽形额毛
designs.feature: rounded peach cheeks, large wet honey-gold eyes, single sprout forelock
designs.eye: 蜂蜜金虹膜＋深琥珀外环；黑色竖椭圆瞳孔
designs.why: 眼睛与额毛共同形成抬头、好奇、愿意试一试的表情记忆。
designs.act: 听见求助先抬头，芽形额毛随着动作轻轻颤动；失败后又探头再试。
designs.risk: 额毛是毛束，不是植物或第三只耳朵；眼睛有湿润感但不持续流泪。
designs.spec: NAME SUNBUD. Apricot-cream short fluffy fur. Design a broad softly heart-shaped kitten face, noticeably fuller lifted peach-like cheek fur, eyes about one fifth larger than realistic kitten eyes, with visible honey-gold irises edged darker amber and big BLACK vertical oval pupils, soft catchlights, not enormous bug eyes. A SINGLE thick short organic fur forelock curls FORWARD above forehead like a little sprouting comma; fur-colored not plant, no stalk accessory. Broad round little body, normal functional cat legs. Small sage-green cotton bib. A softly curved ordinary full tail. Keep low triangular cat ears. Main signature close-up: forward-curving sprout forelock plus cheek silhouette; callouts "HONEY GOLD IRIS", "BLACK OVAL PUPIL", "FORWARD FUR SPROUT", "PEACH CHEEKS". Clearly less ordinary than a breed photo but tactile realistic.
designs.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create a BRAND NEW original character model sheet for a live-action fantasy cat short series. Do not reproduce an ordinary breed photograph: the character must have a memorable, deliberately designed silhouette, subtly exaggerated expressive eyes, and one unmistakable anatomical/fur design motif. Balance: believable photoreal individual fur, real feline nose/paws/whiskers, warm real-world studio lighting, but appealing feature-film creature proportions. NOT flat cartoon, plastic toy, stuffed animal, anime, humanoid, cat-headed person or grotesque. The cat is an optimistic warmhearted helper who still loves life after hardship. Show lively curiosity and gentle self-confidence, not sorrow, not human grin.
Layout: high resolution wide landscape production design board. LEFT 70% is a clean 2x4 turnaround grid of the EXACT SAME cat: top row DAILY with NO wings; bottom row ANGEL same identity with small paired ivory feather wings at upper back. Columns FRONT, PROFILE L (nose points left), BACK, PROFILE R (nose points right). Four-paw natural standing, strict side views, full tail/paws/halo visible, equal scale and aligned ground lines. Thin warm gold halo floats above head in ALL views. Cat face/fur/body proportions/accessory identical in both rows. Wings are only difference.
RIGHT 30% is a separate DETAIL PANEL with THREE large close-ups: (1) large face frontal portrait including eyes/muzzle/ears; (2) extreme close-up ONE EYE with iris color and black pupil clearly visible; (3) enlarged close-up of the signature exaggerated feature specified below, with a small comparison line diagram / proportion callout. These must match the actual cat in the eight views, not introduce new identity. Add concise accurate readable English callout descriptions, label FACE / EYE / SIGNATURE and a short descriptor of each feature. No arbitrary measurements/percentages printed. NO extra cats or scenes.
Off-white neutral background, restrained warm-gray typography, subtle panel dividers, tasteful professional character-design bible layout. Natural fur with readable volumes, believable organic feline anatomy beneath controlled exaggeration. No large clothes. No feather clip or cape. Full character should be memorable even if halo/accessory removed. Not edits, no reference images.
CHARACTER IDENTITY:

designs.name: 听芽 · 一对会认真听的叶耳
designs.motif: 宽圆叶形大耳＋柔软耳缘毛
designs.eye: 浅橄榄绿虹膜＋金色内圈；黑色椭圆瞳孔
designs.why: 耳朵与接收心愿的动作直接关联，正面和剪影都能辨认。
designs.act: 听见细声先转一只耳朵；理解愿望时两耳向前，替代额外台词。
designs.risk: 叶形来自耳廓轮廓，仍是猫耳；不变成兔耳、精灵耳或折耳。
designs.spec: NAME LISTENLEAF. Blue-gray and white short plush cat, white muzzle and white chest, gray back and tail. PRIMARY signature: two slightly oversized WIDE leaf-shaped cat ears, rounded triangular tips and fluffy curved outer rims, about a quarter wider than normal; still short enough clearly feline, never rabbit-long, never folded. Ears lean gently outward at rest, alert and kind. Rounded face and enlarged luminous light olive-green eyes with subtle golden iris inner ring, BLACK oval pupils. A little white daisy below ANATOMICAL LEFT ear, same side in every view, no bib. Compact soft kitten body on normal legs. Eye close-up shows accurate green-gold iris. Signature close-up enlarges ear silhouette, visible fur edge and pink interior. Callouts "OLIVE IRIS / GOLD INNER RING", "SOFT BLACK PUPIL", "WIDE LEAF EARS", "ROUNDED FUR RIM". This is a deliberate ear silhouette recognizable without halo, not ordinary pointy cat ears.

designs.name: 抱抱梨 · 小步快跑的热心团子
designs.motif: 明显梨形胖身子＋小圆爪
designs.feature: pear-shaped plump torso with wide soft lower belly
designs.eye: 焦糖棕虹膜＋暖金内圈；黑色圆椭圆瞳孔
designs.why: 身体轮廓有辨识度，能通过停步、回头和贴近形成温暖又略笨拙的表演。
designs.act: 一听见需要帮忙就迈小步赶过去，到了又放轻动作，不压迫胆小求助者。
designs.risk: 丰满是比例设计，不做病态肥胖或短肢畸形；保留足够腿长和行动空间。
designs.spec: NAME HUGPEAR. Warm orange and white cat, white bib-shaped natural chest and belly, orange crown/back/tail with very sparse soft stripes, four white paws. PRIMARY signature is visibly pear-shaped rounded PLUMP body with a broad soft lower torso and hips, smaller upper chest, comically cuddly but healthy and mobile; four short-looking but anatomically functional cat legs visible, no dwarfism. Head softly round with small normal ears and bright oversized caramel brown eyes with gold iris inner ring, large black rounded-oval pupils. Tiny sky-blue cotton neck bib. Natural medium tail with rounded tip. Must differ strongly from normal slender kittens, especially both side and back silhouettes. No sagging sick belly. Signature panel show whole pear torso close-up side and back small silhouette, not a fruit object. Callouts "CARAMEL IRIS", "ROUND OVAL PUPIL", "SOFT PEAR SILHOUETTE", "SMALL ROUND PAWS".

designs.name: 问问 · 尾巴先举手的小帮手
designs.motif: 粗绒问号尾＋对称奶白眉点
designs.feature: single thick question-mark tail, lifted curved tip
designs.eye: 清透青绿色虹膜；黑色竖椭圆瞳孔
designs.why: 尾巴可以成为远景识别符号，眉点与眼神增强好奇心。
designs.act: 遇到新问题先把尾尖弯起来、探头观察；放松后尾巴自然放下。
designs.risk: 问号是常用尾姿而非僵硬器官；尾巴只能一条，不能变成绳子或发光符号。
designs.spec: NAME QUESTIONTAIL. Chocolate-brown and warm-white bicolor kitten, white muzzle chest and paws, symmetrical small cream oval fur patches ABOVE both eyes like gentle eyebrows (fur markings not human eyebrow hair). Slightly enlarged glossy teal-green irises with BLACK vertical oval pupils; head softly round, playful curious expression, normal little triangular ears. PRIMARY signature is one unusually thick soft plush-furred tail lifted upright and curved at top in a loose QUESTION MARK, not a spiral, not two tails, never a rigid prop. Tail is a normal organic tail with fuller fur, bends naturally, cream tip. Make side/front/back tail shape visible in the turnarounds; do not hide it behind torso. ONE tiny pale butter-yellow bib. Compact body, normal limbs. Signature panel: enlarged tail with curved contour arrow showing relaxed curl, caption "SOFT QUESTION TAIL"; eye "TEAL GREEN IRIS / BLACK OVAL PUPIL"; face "CREAM BROW PATCHES". No human smile.

designs.name: 云兜 · 把温柔装在腮边
designs.motif: 两侧三瓣云朵腮毛＋水蓝圆眼
designs.feature: scalloped cloud-like cheek fur with three soft rounded lobes on each side
designs.eye: 浅水蓝虹膜＋蓝灰外环；黑色圆椭圆瞳孔
designs.why: 脸部轮廓独特，适合慢眨眼、轻蹭和贴耳倾听的近景。
designs.act: 倾听时腮毛随小幅歪头晃动；安心以后轻轻蹭同伴一下。
designs.risk: 云朵轮廓必须由毛发形成，不能变成棉花配件、翅膀或肥大的皮肤肿块。
designs.spec: NAME CLOUDPOUCH. Warm ivory-white semi-short fluffy cat, pale biscuit-colored small ears and tail tip, no other markings. PRIMARY signature: extraordinary soft CLOUD-SCALLOPED CHEEK FUR, each cheek has three broad softly rounded fur lobes, a wide cloud-like lower face, fur is individual real hair and physically soft, not cotton balls stuck on face. Short normal feline muzzle with muted pink nose. Noticeably larger watery pale aqua-blue irises with darker blue-gray outer ring and large BLACK rounded-oval pupils, luminous curious eyes, no tears. Small warm apricot rounded cotton bib. Compact rounded body with normal cat legs, soft normal tail. Signature detail close-up of one cheek with callout "THREE SOFT FUR LOBES" and "CLOUD CHEEK SILHOUETTE"; eye "AQUA IRIS / BLUE GRAY RIM". A friendly sunny look, no melancholy. This face should read designed and recognizable at thumbnail size, not a generic white kitten.
